import requests, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, collections
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
r=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
    params={"query":"(taxonomy_id:6231) AND (xref:pfam-PF02179)",
            "fields":"accession,organism_name,gene_names,length,sequence,xref_pfam","format":"json","size":"500"},timeout=120)
hits=r.json()["results"]
B62_txt="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3

K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
L=B62_txt.strip().split("\n"); cols=L[0].split(); B={}
for l in L[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): B[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return B.get((a,b),B.get((b,a),-4))
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1); pX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1); pY[0,j]=2
    SM=np.array([[sc(a,b) for b in s2] for a in s1],float)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            a=M[i-1,j-1];b=Ix[i-1,j-1];c=Iy[i-1,j-1]
            if a>=b and a>=c: M[i,j]=a+SM[i-1,j-1]; pM[i,j]=0
            elif b>=c: M[i,j]=b+SM[i-1,j-1]; pM[i,j]=1
            else: M[i,j]=c+SM[i-1,j-1]; pM[i,j]=2
            a=M[i-1,j]+go;b=Ix[i-1,j]+ge;c=Iy[i-1,j]+go
            if a>=b and a>=c: Ix[i,j]=a;pX[i,j]=0
            elif b>=c: Ix[i,j]=b;pX[i,j]=1
            else: Ix[i,j]=c;pX[i,j]=2
            a=M[i,j-1]+go;b=Ix[i,j-1]+go;c=Iy[i,j-1]+ge
            if a>=b and a>=c: Iy[i,j]=a;pY[i,j]=0
            elif b>=c: Iy[i,j]=b;pY[i,j]=1
            else: Iy[i,j]=c;pY[i,j]=2
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]])); mp={}
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: mp[i]=j; ns=pM[i,j]; i-=1; j-=1; st=ns
        elif st==1: ns=pX[i,j]; i-=1; st=ns
        else: ns=pY[i,j]; j-=1; st=ns
    return mp, float(max(M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]))

WORM="MKVNVSCSSVQTTIDILEENQGEDESILTLGQLRDRIATDNDVDVETMKLLHRGKFLQGADDVSLSTLNFKENDKIIVMGGKNALVDDAGFKMLM"[:91]
POS={8:'L8-eq',49:'R42-eq',51:'I44-eq',52:'F45-eq',55:'K48-eq',77:'H68-eq',79:'V70-eq',81:'R72-eq'}
rows=[]
for h in hits:
    acc=h["primaryAccession"]; org=h["organism"]["scientificName"]; s=h["sequence"]["value"]
    pf=sorted({c["id"] for c in h.get("uniProtKBCrossReferences",[]) if c["database"]=="Pfam"})
    sub=s[:min(len(s),170)]
    mp,score=nw(WORM,sub)
    if score<60: 
        rows.append(dict(acc=acc,org=org,score=round(score),ULD="absent/undetected",pfam=",".join(pf)))
        continue
    rec=dict(acc=acc,org=org,score=round(score),ULD="present",pfam=",".join(pf))
    for p,lab in POS.items():
        j=mp.get(p); rec[lab]= sub[j-1] if j else "-"
    rows.append(rec)
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
# deduplicate by organism keeping best score
df=df.sort_values("score",ascending=False).drop_duplicates("org")
present=df[df.ULD=="present"]
print(f"nematode BAG-domain proteins: {len(hits)}; unique organisms: {len(df)}; with detectable ULD: {len(present)}")
print("\n--- per-position composition across nematode BAG-1 orthologs with a ULD ---")
summ=[]
for p,lab in POS.items():
    cnt=collections.Counter(present[lab]); tot=sum(cnt.values())
    top=cnt.most_common(4)
    summ.append(dict(position=lab, worm_BAG1=f"{WORM[p-1]}{p}",
                     composition="; ".join(f"{a}:{n}({100*n/tot:.0f}%)" for a,n in top),
                     frac_same_as_worm=round(100*cnt[WORM[p-1]]/tot,1),
                     frac_ubq_residue=round(100*cnt[{8:'L',49:'R',51:'I',52:'F',55:'K',77:'H',79:'V',81:'R'}[p]]/tot,1)))
sdf=pd.DataFrame(summ); print(sdf.to_string(index=False))
print("\n--- per-species table (ULD present) ---")
print(present[["org","acc","pfam"]+list(POS.values())].to_string(index=False))
print("\n--- ULD absent/undetected ---")
print(df[df.ULD!="present"][["org","acc","score","pfam"]].to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,4.5))
labs=list(POS.values()); x=np.arange(len(labs))
ax.bar(x-0.2,sdf["frac_ubq_residue"],0.4,label="matches the ubiquitin residue",color="#4C78A8")
ax.bar(x+0.2,sdf["frac_same_as_worm"],0.4,label="matches C. elegans BAG-1",color="#F58518")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([f"{l}\n({sdf['worm_BAG1'][i]})" for i,l in enumerate(labs)])
ax.set_ylabel("% of nematode BAG-1 orthologs"); ax.set_ylim(0,105)
ax.set_title(f"Conservation at ubiquitin proteasome-surface positions\nacross {len(present)} nematode BAG-1 orthologs with a ubiquitin-like domain")
ax.legend(fontsize=8); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
present.to_csv("/tmp/nem_patch.csv",index=False)
